submissions.title: HUMAIN partners with DataVolt to jointly develop 100MW of a 360MW AI data center project in NEOM
submissions.excerpt: HUMAIN partners with DataVolt to jointly develop 100MW of a 360MW AI data center project in NEOM
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker currently records this project as status ANNOUNCED with power as a 1,500 MW estimate (whole-campus target) and analyst notes describing a '~300 MW' first phase targeted for 2028. NEOM's Aug 31, 2026 release (echoed by AGBI, ITP.net, Construction Review, SaudiGulf Projects) states HUMAIN and DataVolt have now broken ground: construction is underway on a 360 MW first phase of the wider 1.5 GW Oxagon campus, with HUMAIN developing a 100 MW increment inside it and the first 100 MW targeted live in 2028. Recommended correction: (1) move status from ANNOUNCED to UNDER_CONSTRUCTION now that groundbreaking is confirmed by a primary source; (2) update the first-phase figure from '~300 MW' to 360 MW. The 1.5 GW campus total remains a future target, not current capacity, and should stay in the estimated column. IT-load-vs-site-power basis is still not stated by DataVolt/NEOM/HUMAIN in any source reviewed -- flag as unclear, not IT load.

claims.methodology: NEOM/HUMAIN joint announcement, Aug 31 2026: construction begun on a 360 MW first phase of the 1.5 GW Oxagon campus (DataVolt), with HUMAIN developing a 100 MW increment within it; first 100 MW targeted live 2028. Basis: unclear -- IT load vs. site power not stated by the announcing parties.
